title: require-replaces proposal
body:
Changelog: Feature: New ``[replace_requires]`` and ``[replace_tool_requires]`` in profile for redefining requires, useful for package replacements like ``zlibng/zlib``, to solve conflicts, and to replace some dependencies by system alternatives wrapped in another Conan package recipe.
Docs: https://github.com/conan-io/docs/pull/3495

Complement https://github.com/conan-io/conan/pull/14871
